verdict.rationale: Calendar sync is a fair question for a CRM like Salesmate, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents syncing an external calendar or showing meetings on contact or deal timelines. The AI meeting-booking claim (salesmate-docs-13) and generic activity management (salesmate-docs-1) are adjacent features, not calendar sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines
